sohala.name: Sanjivan samadhi sohala (Kartiki)
sohala.tithi: Samadhi tithi Trayodashi (Vishwakosh). Festival run Shashthi to Amavasya per Marathi Wikipedia; biggest day Ekadashi per en Wikipedia; Bridge Chronicle says the 2024 celebrations began on Ashtami
sohala.usual_gregorian_window: Late November to early December. Only data point: Ekadashi day was Tuesday 26 Nov 2024 (the 728th anniversary). 2026: Ekadashi Friday 4 Dec; samadhi day Sunday 6 Dec (see DNYG-P-OB01 to OB06).
sohala.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (per local practice; newspapers opened do not all name it)
sohala.rituals: Pavamaan abhishek and dudharathi before dawn, kakda bhajan at Muktai Mandap, mahapuja, mahanaivedya, rathotsav, kirtan at Veena Mandap, nagar pradakshina with the silver mask, bath in the Indrayani (2024 programme)
sohala.notes: Sources disagree on which Vadya days make up the festival; tithi of the samadhi (Trayodashi) is separate from the Ekadashi peak. Newspapers call the peak Kartiki Ekadashi, which is not the Prabodhini Ekadashi two weeks earlier. 2026 programme: the festival opens on Haibatbaba's payri pujan on 1 Dec and ends on 8 Dec, so it does not follow the Shashthi-to-Amavasya span in Marathi Wikipedia (Amavasya falls on 8 Dec per one calendar page, DNYG-P-S19). Administration preparations (Alandi municipal hall meeting, 17 Nov) aim to finish by 30 Nov; police deployment starts 1 Dec; about 1,000 mobile toilets and 180 CCTV cameras are planned (Pudhari, 18 Nov).
sohala.programme_2026: Announced 16 Nov 2026 in Pudhari and eSakal: Akhand Harinam Saptah from 29 Nov (Pudhari only); sohala opens 1 Dec with the step-worship (payri pujan) of Haibatbaba at the Deulwada; Kartik Vadya Ekadashi on Friday 4 Dec (main pre-dawn puja); Dwadashi 5 Dec with the rathotsav at 4 pm; samadhi day Sunday 6 Dec (noon observance); wari concludes Tuesday 8 Dec with the night palkhi circuit of the town and the Chhabina procession.
sohala.revision_note: Added the 2026 programme from Pudhari and eSakal (16 Nov 2026), checked against five calendar pages for the tithi dates. Existing 2024 text kept.

sohala.name: Kartik Vadya Ekadashi 2026 at Alandi (Kartiki yatra peak)
sohala.tithi: Ekadashi of the waning fortnight of Kartik (amanta; Margashirsha Krishna in the north-Indian count). Tithi runs 11:04 PM 3 Dec to 11:45 PM 4 Dec (New Delhi, PanchangBodh); Hyderabad panchang ends it 11:44 PM on 4 Dec
sohala.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (not named in the two newspapers; the chief trustee performs the samadhi-day puja per Pudhari)
sohala.rituals: Pre-dawn main puja at the samadhi by 12 Brahmavrinda with Vedic chanting; temple open for darshan all day; the palkhi leaves Deulwada at 1 pm for a town circuit and returns about 9 pm (Pudhari)

sohala.name: Sanjeevan Samadhi day 2026 (Kartik Vadya Trayodashi)
sohala.tithi: Trayodashi of the waning fortnight; Krishna Trayodashi runs from about 12:51 AM on 6 Dec to 2:22 AM on 7 Dec (New Delhi, Drik Panchang); Ravi Pradosh Vrat that day
sohala.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (not named in the two newspapers; the chief trustee performs the samadhi-day puja per Pudhari)
sohala.rituals: Pavamaan abhishek and milk aarti by the chief trustee 3-4 am; devotees' puja on the chal paduka 5-9:30 am; kirtans at the Mahadwar (7-9 am) and Veena Mandap; a kirtan on the samadhi episode by Namdev's descendants 9 am to noon; the samadhi observance at noon (Pudhari). Both newspapers give 6 Dec as the samadhi day; neither uses the word Trayodashi, which comes from the calendar pages.

sohala.name: Sohala opening 2026: Haibatbaba step-worship
sohala.tithi: Not stated (about Kartik Vadya Ashtami by count; not computed)
sohala.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (not named in the two newspapers; the chief trustee performs the samadhi-day puja per Pudhari)
sohala.rituals: Opening ceremony of the wari: payri pujan of Guru Haibatbaba at the Deulwada, Alandi (Pudhari, eSakal). Pudhari adds that an Akhand Harinam Saptah begins on 29 Nov (single source).

sohala.name: Wari conclusion 2026: night palkhi circuit and Chhabina procession
sohala.tithi: Not stated; Amavasya per one calendar page
sohala.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (not named in the two newspapers; the chief trustee performs the samadhi-day puja per Pudhari)
sohala.rituals: Night palkhi circuit of the town and the Chhabina procession mark the end of the Kartiki wari (Pudhari); eSakal gives the end date 8 Dec in its headline only.

sohala.name: Dwadashi 2026: government puja and rathotsav
sohala.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (not named in the two newspapers; the chief trustee performs the samadhi-day puja per Pudhari)
sohala.rituals: Government puja about 3:30 am with the Prant Officer present; palkhi leaves Deulwada at 4 pm for the traditional rathotsav (Pudhari only).

sohala.name: Akhand Harinam Saptah 2026 (start)
sohala.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (not named in the two newspapers; the chief trustee performs the samadhi-day puja per Pudhari)
sohala.rituals: Continuous Harinam chanting week begins 29 Nov (Pudhari only). Whether it ends on the samadhi day is not stated.
